findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Capture the child-environment projection contract and per-adapter secret-name registry (ownership: trusted-inherit / owning-overlay / sibling-strip; names-not-values invariant) in an ADR / AGENTS.md / design-doc update.
evidence: 'Add src/rebar/_child_env.py with a pure environment projection API and a checked-in registry of exact secret names owned by each Rebar adapter.'
No design-doc/ADR/AGENTS.md update is referenced for the new projection contract or the registry's ownership semantics (trusted-inherit vs owning-overlay vs sibling-strip).
findings.finding: The plan introduces a novel shared child-environment projection API plus a checked-in registry of exact secret names owned by each Rebar adapter — a new cross-component pattern/contract threaded through many paths — but names no ADR / AGENTS.md / design-doc capture of this architectural decision.
scenarios: A future adapter author adds a secret but does not register its exact name, so an unrelated sibling child silently retains it.
A maintainer changes the projection semantics without a documented contract to reason against.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a plan bullet committing to an ADR or AGENTS.md entry documenting the _child_env projection API, the registry's name-only invariant, and how each adapter registers its owned secret names.
